name: csharp.list_views
description: List views in the active document, optionally filtered by name substring and/or view type (Plan, Elevation, Section, ThreeD, etc.). Returns id, name, type, scale for each. Use as the discovery step before bulk operations on views — especially before csharp.create_sheets_from_views.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on view name (e.g. 'Elevation', 'Lobby')

type.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on view type (e.g. 'Elevation', 'FloorPlan', 'Section')
